asked: Re-read Agent Script primitives after user prompted 'is there a way to make it more deterministic? using agent script'

With available_when on Submit + mutable bool confirmation_accepted gated by accept_confirmation @utils.setVariables call (itself gated by pending_application_key != ''), the Submit action is structurally invisible to the LLM unless the gate is open. Model cannot fabricate tool references. Designed iter 5: 4 new variables, 2 new helper actions (stage_request, accept_confirmation), Submit action wired to read from variables (not from slot-fill) with available_when gate. Net structural primitive count: 0 require_user_confirmation flips, 2 available_when guards, 2 setVariables tool calls, 4 mutable variables. No Salesforce-native UI dependency.

Action contract HelpIqAgentMultiplierSoftwareRequests has only 3 inputs (accessTypeKey, applicationKey, reasonForAccess) — no requestor field; runtime infers from session, so on-behalf-of is structurally impossible to fulfill via this path. AFTER the ticket was already filed and handed off. The misleading prompt suggests user can still add info to the ticket — they can't. Prior prompt only said 'do not offer to augment the ticket' which the model ignored. Same class of prompt-only enforcement failure we've seen elsewhere; same fix shape — provide literal template + explicit forbidden examples + hard-rule with past-failure citation.
